finalText:
The footprint golden test fails because of a bug in the area function, not because the test is wrong. I fixed the code and left the test as it was. `npm run golden`, `npm test` and `npm run types` all pass now. I didn't run the full `npm run check` (docs, architecture and backlog checks), which may also run in CI.

**Cause:** the input ring doesn't repeat its first point at the end, but the area loop in `packages/geo-model3d/src/footprint-area.js` stopped one point early. It never added the side from the last corner back to the first. For the 10×8 test rectangle at (2,1)–(12,9) that gave 88 m² instead of 80. The expected value is right (10 × 8 = 80, per v0.3 §12).

**Fix:** the loop now goes through every corner and wraps the last one back to the first. That's a 2-line change, plus a comment.

Nothing is committed or pushed yet. Want me to commit and push so CI goes green before your demo? This repo tracks work through backlog items and decision IDs, so tell me if the commit should reference one.
